description: Fetches the organization details for a given Trello action, if the action has an associated organization.

fields.description: Specifies which fields of the organization resource to return. Use 'all' to fetch all available fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Allowed fields include: billableMemberCount, desc, descData, displayName, idBoards, invitations, invited, logoHash, memberships, name, powerUps, prefs, premiumFeatures, products, url, website.
fields.title: Fields

idAction.description: The unique identifier of the Trello action for which organization details are being requested.
idAction.title: Id Action

name: get_actions_organization_by_id_action

asciiName.description: ASCII-formatted version of the organization name.
asciiName.title: Ascii Name

billableMemberCount.description: Count of billable members in the organization.
billableMemberCount.title: Billable Member Count

dateLastActivity.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent board activity in the organization.
dateLastActivity.title: Date Last Activity

dateLastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the organization was last updated.
dateLastUpdated.title: Date Last Updated

descData.description: Structured data related to the organization description.
descData.title: Desc Data

displayName.description: The display name of the organization shown to users.
displayName.title: Display Name

id.description: The unique identifier (TrelloID) of the organization, 24 character hex string.
id.title: Id

idAdmins.description: Array of member IDs who have admin privileges in the organization.
idAdmins.title: Id Admins

idBoards.description: Array of board IDs that belong to this organization.
idBoards.title: Id Boards

idEnterprise.description: The enterprise ID if this organization belongs to an enterprise.
idEnterprise.title: Id Enterprise

idInvitedMembers.description: Array of member IDs who have been invited to the organization.
idInvitedMembers.title: Id Invited Members

idMembers.description: Array of member IDs who belong to the organization.
idMembers.title: Id Members

invitations.description: Pending invitation details for the organization.
invitations.title: Invitations

invited.description: Indicates whether there are pending invitations.
invited.title: Invited

logoHash.description: Hash identifier for the organization's logo image.
logoHash.title: Logo Hash

logoUrl.description: Direct URL to the organization's logo image.
logoUrl.title: Logo Url

memberships.description: Array of membership objects containing detailed member information including role and status.
memberships.title: Memberships

powerUpIds.description: Array of Power-Up identifiers enabled for the organization.
powerUpIds.title: Power Up Ids

premiumFeatures.description: Array of premium feature identifiers available to the organization.
premiumFeatures.title: Premium Features

products.description: Array of product identifiers/numbers associated with the organization's subscriptions.
products.title: Products

url.description: The URL to the organization's Trello workspace (e.g., https://trello.com/w/<name>).
url.title: Url

associatedDomain.description: Domain associated with the organization for member validation.
associatedDomain.title: Associated Domain

attachmentRestrictions.description: Array of allowed attachment sources (e.g., ['computer', 'trello', 'google drive']).
attachmentRestrictions.title: Attachment Restrictions

boardDeleteRestrict.description: Restrictions on who can delete boards in the organization.
boardDeleteRestrict.title: Board Delete Restrict

externalMembersDisabled.description: Whether external members are disabled for this organization.
externalMembersDisabled.title: External Members Disabled

orgInviteRestrict.description: Array of email domain restrictions for organization invitations.
orgInviteRestrict.title: Org Invite Restrict
